rules.rule: Frontend imports flow one way through the FSD layers.
rules.anchor: app → pages → widgets → features → entities → shared

rules.rule: Cross-slice imports go through the slice public API.
The feature manifest is the machine-readable feature inventory.
Layer rules live in fsd.rules.json in strict mode.
api.ts holds only the Axios instance; no browser globals.
Browser storage is reached only through safeStorage.
Query data is not mirrored into form state inside useEffect.
rules.anchor: Do not mirror React Query data into form state

rules.rule: Every controller handler carries @ApiOperation and a typed @ApiResponse.
Response DTOs convert Prisma Date to z.string().
Server errors keep one response shape.
Public /t/* DTOs expose student-safe fields only.
Paired client/server implementations stay in parity.
typecheck stays in both pipelines; it is the only step that compiles server specs.
rules.anchor: it is the only one that compiles the server specs

rules.rule: Version bumps stay inside the current major of the declared stack.
rules.anchor: Version bumps stay inside the current major

rules.rule: Orval, Zustand, TanStack Query and FSD are not replaced.
rules.anchor: do not replace Orval, Zustand, TanStack Query or FSD

rules.rule: A check is never disabled, commented out or hardcoded around.
rules.anchor: Never disable a check, comment out failing logic, or hardcode around a gate

rules.rule: The change is classified (existing feature vs new feature) before any scaffolding.
Schema, generate, migration, backend, gen:api, frontend, verification — in this order.
The API client is regenerated before any frontend check when DTOs or controllers changed.
rules.anchor: Regenerate the API client before any frontend lint/build/test step

rules.rule: pages/* are thin route entrypoints; logic lives in widgets and features.
llmStatus, never status, signals that the AI phase finished.
rules.anchor: is therefore never a completion signal for the AI

rules.rule: The project is started from the root compose file only.
rules.anchor: Normal startup is the root compose file only

rules.rule: The devcontainer compose file is never used to run the project.
rules.anchor: never use it to run the project

rules.rule: verify:template is mandatory before finalizing branch state.
rules.anchor: release gate, mandatory before finalizing branch state

rules.rule: A changed gate is re-run after deleting the session's generated artifacts.
Shared logic extracted from two implementations matches the authority and is diffed against both.
Deleting code removes its dead exports and its documentation mentions in the same change.
rules.anchor: Its dead exports and its mentions in the docs go in the same change

rules.rule: A file move records the baseline first and requires the same numbers afterwards.
git check-ignore decides what is an artifact; the generated API client is committed.
After gen:api the real change is read from git diff --numstat.
Scripted edits normalise line endings in memory and convert once on write.
Tailwind 4 runs through @tailwindcss/postcss with the existing HSL theme.
New flex and grid layouts use gap rather than space-x/space-y.
bd is the only task tracker.
No commit or push without clear authority.
rules.anchor: Do not commit or push without clear authority

rules.rule: Graph traces pass include_tests: true because `tests` is product code here.
